steps.title: Check Terraform CLI
steps.description: Verify Terraform CLI is ready to use in your environment.

verification.command: terraform --version 2>&1 | grep -i 'Terraform' && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Write Your First Manifest
steps.description: Create a main.tf file with local provider resources.
tasks: Create `main.tf`: `echo 'resource "local_file" "pet" { filename = "/tmp/pet.txt" content = "My Pet Cat" }' > main.tf`
